_doc: WP-Q8: the world-kit pieces (packs, member files, Poly Haven slugs), each packed by world_kits.pack_piece into one self-contained GLB (base-colour image only, scaled to max_texture_px) and registered external in assets/library.json (vault assets/3d/model/<id>/). `sha256` is the packed file's hash, written by `world_kits register`; `fetch` rebuilds a missing file from the pack zip or the Poly Haven URLs and refuses other bytes. Licences: licence_sources.json rows quaternius_medieval_village_megakit and polyhaven.

mvk.version: Standard (free) zip, itch.io page licence line 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal' and the pack's License_Standard.txt (CC0 1.0), downloaded 2026-11-05
